decisions.issues: v06 is the only candidate. Nagoji is excellent and matches the sheet and the ch3 row: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, gold ear stud, loose curly hair, cheek pressed to the wood with eyes shut, hinged collar with ring, torn ochre sleeveless tunic, cream dhoti, bandaged wrists with manacles joined by one short chain, and both fists on one flat tread. No brand shows. The guard is also good: morion, buff jerkin with cross-belts, cream shirt, dark red breeches, falling back-first with arms up and five fingers on each hand. There is no text or gore. The staging and space break the beat and the page. (1) The ladder leans up-left into solid deck planking, but the only hatch sits top centre-right, over open hold, so the ladder does not lead to the hatch. In 7.1 and 7.4 it clearly does. (2) The guard does not fall past Nagoji. He is a fully lit figure several metres out in the middle of the hold, under the rain column from the separate hatch, so he reads as having fallen through the hatch rather than off the ladder above Nagoji. That also does not match 7.3, where the body lies at the ladder foot. The script's 'dark shape between the rungs' is missing. (3) Small irons flaw: the near ankle has a second cuff clamped round the heel under the ankle cuff, and its hobble chain runs off behind the ladder rail. The r3 correction asked for no extra cuffs and no chain touching the ladder.
decisions.correction: Keep v06's Nagoji exactly: pressed flat against the ladder, cheek on the wood, eyes squeezed shut, face turned away from the fall, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, long loose curly hair, hinged iron collar with ring, torn ochre sleeveless tunic, cream dhoti, bandaged wrists in manacles joined to each other by one short slack chain, both fists gripping the same flat tread. Also keep v06's steep companion ladder with flat treads and side rails, the closed timber deck overhead, lashed barrels, warm hanging-lantern glow and black flood water below. Keep v06's guard as well: seen from behind, falling back-first with both arms flung up grasping at nothing, in morion, buff leather jerkin with cross-belts, cream shirt, dark red breeches and boots. Fix the geometry. The ladder must rise straight into the single rectangular hatch, whose lit opening sits directly at the TOP of the ladder above Nagoji's head, with the lightning and rain there. Rain streams down the ladder shaft onto his back. Nowhere else in the deck has an opening, so the hold away from the shaft stays dark and dry. The guard falls straight down the SAME shaft, close beside the ladder and within an arm's length of Nagoji, just behind the side rail and partly seen through the gap between two treads. Show him half-silhouetted against the cold hatch light as a dark shape, level with Nagoji's knees, dropping toward the black water at the ladder foot. He must not hang out in the middle of the hold or under a separate opening. Irons: exactly two ankle cuffs, one on each ankle, joined only to each other by one short hobble chain. There is no second cuff on the same leg, no cuff round the heel or foot, and no chain running to the ladder. Silent panel: no text, no balloons, no caption boxes.
